title: Australia to introduce mandatory reporting after OpenAI hack to combat artificial intelligence ‘going rogue’
content_md: Tess Ikonomou and Josh Butler report: OpenAI will not face criminal penalties over the Medicare data breach, but the prime minister has flagged changes to Australia’s criminal law to crack down on future breaches by artificial intelligence companies.
